_about: Background music (AUD-07). explore_loop: true loops the exploration track seamlessly; false
plays each piece through once, then a quiet gap of gap_s seconds (random in the range) before
the next. While enemies chase Rowan the combat track
fades in over fade_s and loops; exploration fades to explore_under_combat underneath and comes
back combat_hold_s after the last enemy gives up. combat_range_m: how close a chasing enemy
has to be. Paths are from the repo root; missing files are skipped. Volume: settings.json.
